name: 风云III (3.0)
english_description: Like fy2mg, this belongs to the “Jinyong Qunxiazhuan”/XKX framework family — the login flow, check_legal_name, password complexity rules, and ethnicity selection are byte-for-byte identical — but its game content and title are different, and its master file hash does not match any of the other “Storm”-branded games in this collection (fy2, fys, fysjmb, jhfy2, jhfy3, fyzfqyy, fy2qh, fy3dz, fy3xd, jhfy, zzfy, zzfy3, fengyun434, fy2005).
